# open-videocore

> Headless, API-first media asset management middleware for ingesting, transcoding, packaging, searching, and delivering video — running entirely on Open Source Cloud.

## Guides

- [Ingesting media](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/guide-ingest.html): Get source video into open-videocore: from a URL, direct upload, presigned/multipart upload, or an object storage watch-folder.
- [Transcoding & packaging](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/guide-transcode-package.html): Turn source media into an ABR ladder and package it as HLS/DASH — as separate steps, or chained in one pipeline.
- [Metadata, tags & search](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/guide-metadata-search.html): Attach descriptive and technical metadata, tag assets, and find them again with full-text and filtered search.
- [Thumbnails, clips & export](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/guide-thumbnails-clips-export.html): Extract poster frames, cut a sub-segment into a new asset, and re-wrap into a different container.
- [Delivery & playback](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/guide-delivery.html): Get a playable URL for an asset — proxied HLS/DASH manifests or a presigned source download.
- [Organizing: collections & webhooks](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/guide-organizing.html): Group related assets into collections, and get HTTP notifications when asset and job state changes.
- [Operating a workspace](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/guide-operating.html): Provision a workspace's backing stack, tune the transcoder auto-scaler, manage storage buckets, and configure retention.

## Agentic examples

- [Agentic examples](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/agentic-examples.html): Example prompts for driving open-videocore from an AI agent — send a large file for review, build a highlights collection, get notified on completion — with the real API calls each one makes.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/introduction.html): What open-videocore is, how it's put together, and the core REST conventions — identifiers, timestamps, sync vs. async — behind its API.
- [Data model](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/data-model.html): The core entities open-videocore manages — Asset, Job, Pipeline Execution, Profile, Collection, Webhook, Stack, and more — and how they relate.
- [Installation](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/installation.html): Step-by-step instructions for launching an instance of open-videocore on Open Source Cloud (OSC).
- [Authentication & errors](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/authentication.html): How to authenticate requests to the open-videocore API with a bearer token, plus its error and status-code conventions.

## API reference

- [Health](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-health.html): Liveness probes.
- [Provisioning](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-provisioning.html): Provision and tear down a workspace's full OSC media stack (object storage, metadata store, queue).
- [Optional services](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-optional-services.html): Discover and provision add-on OSC services for a workspace.
- [Profiles](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-profiles.html): Transcoding profiles served to the transcoder via the public, unauthenticated index.yml endpoint.
- [Assets](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-assets.html): Asset lifecycle, ingest, upload, transcode, package, thumbnails, tracks, tags, delivery.
- [Jobs](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-jobs.html): Background job status for asynchronous asset operations.
- [Pipelines](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-pipelines.html): Multi-step pipeline execution records.
- [Transcoder jobs](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-encore.html): Direct transcoding job submission and status, bypassing the asset pipeline.
- [Auto-scaler](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-scaler.html): Runtime configuration and status of the transcoder instance auto-scaler.
- [Retention](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-retention.html): Soft-delete / retention window configuration.
- [Logs](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-logs.html): Structured application log query.
- [Search](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-search.html): Full-text and metadata search across assets.
- [Webhooks](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-webhooks.html): HTTP event notification registrations.
- [Collections](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-collections.html): Named groups for organising assets.
- [Storage](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-storage.html): Object storage bucket and watch-folder management.
- [Admin](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-admin.html): Watch-folder poller control.
- [Internal callbacks](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-internal.html): Called by the transcoder and packager services — not for direct client use.
- [Ops UI](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/ref-ui.html): Built-in browser dashboard.
- [API reference](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/api-reference.html): Every open-videocore REST API endpoint (100 across 18 resource groups), generated straight from the committed openapi.json.

[Full text of every page](https://videocore.pages.osaas.io/llms-full.txt)
